RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday,  the April 26, 2007/Vaisakha 6, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Prime Minister; Atomic Energy; Coal; Communications and
Information Technology; Development of North Eastern Region;
External Affairs; Housing and Urban Poverty Alleviation; Overseas
Indian Affairs; Panchayati Raj; Personnel, Public Grievances
and Pensions; Planning; Shipping, Road Transport and
Highways; Space; Statistics and Programme
Implementation; Urban Development;
Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 20
108
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Criteria for identification of BPL
people
*341. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the criteria adopted to identify the
people below poverty line;
(b) whether it is uniform in all the States;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) the details of parameters in different
States?
Ascertaining people living below
poverty line
†*342. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 'Uniform
Recall Period' and 'Mixed Recall Period'
systems are used to ascertain the number
of people living below the poverty line;
(b) if so, the facts thereof and in what
way the calculation is made under the
systems; and
(c) the assessment of the income of
poor people under both the systems at
present?
Residential buildings in Delhi
*343. SHRI O.T. LEPCHA: Will the
Minister of URBAN DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any new
proposal to construct residential buildings
for the welfare of the Central Government
employees in Delhi;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have allotted
any land for this purpose in Delhi; and
(d) if so, the location-wise details
thereof and if not, the reasons therefor?

109
Scrapping of PESB's recommended
panel
*344. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of occasions on which
PESB's recommended panel had been
scrapped for reasons other than vigilance/
corruption since formation of Public
Enterprises Selection Board (PESB) in
1987; and
(b) the details thereof, year-wise and
unit-wise?
Joint declaration at SAARC Summit
*345. SHRI T.S. BAJWA: Will the
Minister of EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the joint declaration
issued after the conclusion of the SAARC
Summit held in New Delhi, recently; and
(b) to what extent, it is expected to
improve bilateral relations between India
and Pakistan?
Vijayawada-Ranchi NH in
Orissa
*346. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS  be
pleased to state:
(a) what is the status of Vijayawada-
Ranchi Highway Project which passes
through Orissa;
(b) whether Government are aware that
this project passes through 12 tribal
dominated districts of Orissa and on
completion, it would open up
opportunities for a large number of tribals
to improve their economy; and
(c) if so, what is the time-frame within
which it would be taken up and completed?
Manpower requirement in IT sector
*347. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether any study has been
conducted to assess the manpower
requirement in the Information Technology
Sector;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) the action taken to fill up the gap of
demand and supply of manpower?
Problems of NER
*348. SHRIMATI SYEDA ANWARA
TAIMUR: Will the PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Eleventh
Plan has recognized the special problems
of the North East Region such as its
geographical location, inadequacy of
physical infrastructure, low level of
entrepreneurship, etc.;
(b) if so, the steps Government have
taken to tackle the North East Region
problems during Eleventh Five Year Plan;
and
(c) the funds allocated during the
Eleventh Five Year Plan?
Expenditure by CPWD
*349. SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the capital and revenue

110
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
expenditures made by the CPWD in last
three financial years, quarter-wise;
(b) whether it is a fact that a larger part
of the annual Budget is spent during the
fourth quarter of the financial year despite
the directives of Ministry of Finance;
(c) what are the details of the directives;
and
(c) the steps that are being taken to avoid
such a situation?
Supply of nuclear fuel to India
†*350. SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that some
countries have given their consent for
supplying nuclear fuel to India;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the names of the countries with
which India is holding talks in this

595
Objectives for creating NAC
2572. SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the objectives behind creation of
National Advisory Council (NAC);
(b) the details of composition of the
NAC at its inception and as at present duly
indicating details of resignations/
substitutions, if any and the issues it dealt
with during these periods especially during
the current year till February, 2007;
(c) the details of funds allotted and
expenses incurred on account of the NAC,
year-wise;
(d) whether any exercise to review the
utility of the NAC vis-a vis the objectives
behind its creation within the Government
has been conducted;
(e) if so, the details thereof indicating
their outcome; and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?
Atomic energy target set
for 2020
2573. SHRI VIJAYKUMAR
RUPANI: Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) the target set for atomic energy
production in Vision 2020 looking to the
potential of atomic energy of the
country;
(b) the total production of atomic energy
as on 31st December, 2006 as against the
target of 5000 MW in the year 2000;
(c) the plans of Nuclear Power
Corporation and National Thermal Power
Corporation to reach the target set for 2020;
and
(d) whether it is a fact that some
environmentalists are opposing the
establishment of Atomic Power Plants in
the country?

596
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Disposal of atomic energy waste
2574. MS. MABEL REBELLO : Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the places where the waste of atomic
energy of various plants in India is disposed
of;
(b) the detials thereof, plant-wise and
area-wise;
(c) the quantity of atomic energy waste
produced annually in India;
(d) whether any study has so far been
undertaken on the ill-effects of the waste
of atomic energy in India;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?
Aryan coal washery Dipika
†2575. SHRI RAMADHAR
KASHYAP: Will the PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to refer to the answer to
Unstarred Question 1805 given in the Rajya
Sabha on the 15th March, 2007 and state:
(a) whether the Aryan Coal Benefication
Private Ltd. which is situated on the land
given on lease to Dipika Gevra (village Beltikri)
mine by S.E.C.L. is not a barrel coal washery;
(b) whether more than 65 per cent
production of ashes (reject) is possible in
Aryan coal washery Dipika and whether it
has been investigated by the competent
authority; and
(c) if not, whether it is proposed to be
investigated?
Allotment of coal blocks to MSMC
2576. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT : Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
of Maharashtra has recommended allotment
of coal blocks to Maharashtra State Mining
Corporation;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the decision taken on the proposal?
Coal royalty to Jharkhand
2577. MS. MABEL REBELLO : Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the total quantity of coal which is
being excavated from Jharkhand annually;
(b) the total quantity of it which is sent
out of the State annually;
(c) the amount of royalty Jharkhand
gets annually; and
(d) the figures  for the last five years,
year-wise?
Compensation to the families of coal
mine accident victims
2578. SHRI MOINUL HASSAN: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the comparative figures of accidents
that took place in various coal mines during
the last five years;
(b) the allotment so far made for safety
measure in each public sector coal mines;
(c) the nature of punishment awarded
to those persons, who are directly or
indirectly responsible for accidents due to
negligence of the management in which a
number of coal workers died during the last
five years; and
(d) the compensation so far made to the
deceased families?
Captive coal mining
2579. SHRI  AMIR ALAM KHAN:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government plan to allocate
38 coal blocks for captive coal mining to
the power, iron, steel and cement sectors;

597
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b)  if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the applications have since
been invited from the concerned agencies;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) by when these blocks are likely to
be allocated?
Difference in transportation rates of
SECL

be pleased to state:
(a) whether
